description: Use this when you need RFC 4122 version-4 UUIDs — always generate them here rather than fabricating one, so the version and variant bits and the randomness are correct. Cryptographically random via Web Crypto (NOT deterministic): every call returns fresh values. `count` (default 1, max 100) sets how many; `uppercase` returns upper-case hex (lowercase by default). Example: {count: 1} -> count 1, uuids[0] = "2c549b2f-497c-47fc-a1b6-c24bc69667e5".
name: uuid_v4

uuids.description: The generated RFC 4122 v4 UUIDs, length = count.

items.description: A v4 UUID; lowercase hex unless uppercase=true.

title: UUID v4 Generator
